attchmntText: Iris Clothings Limited has informed the Exchange about Bonus

Iris Clothings Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at its meeting held on August 26, 2020, have considered and approved bonus at the ratio of 5 : 2, i.e 5 Equity Shares for every 2 Equity Shares held.

Iris Clothings Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on Jun 29, 2020.we hereby inform you under Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, that a meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company was held today i.e. on Monday, 29th day of June, 2020 at the registered office of the company. The Board of Directors of the company has considered and approved the following:-1. Audited Financial Results along with Auditor s Report thereon for the Half Year and Year ended 31st March, 2020.2. In accordance with Regulation 33 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the following documents are enclosed herewith:-i. Audited Financial Results for the Half year and year ended 31st March, 2020.ii. The Declaration- Disclosure pursuant to Regulation 33(3)(d) of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 (as amended) for the audit report with unmodified opinion.iii. The certificate pursuant to Regulation 33(2)(a) of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 (as amended) of the Managing Director and Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of the company, certifying that the financial statements do not contain any false, misleading statements or figures and do not omit any material fact which may make the statement or figures contained therein misleading.The meeting commenced at  11:00 A.M and concluded at 04:00 P.M.You are requested to take on record the aforesaid information for your reference and record.

Iris Clothings Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'UNDERTAKING OF FUNCTIONAL WEBSITE'.This is to inform you that our company, Iris Clothings Limited has a functional website- www.irisclothings.in containing the basic information about the company. We are ensuring on a regular basis that the contents of the website are correct and we update any change in the content of our website within two working days from the date of such change in content.Kindly take it on your record and reference.

Iris Clothings Limited has informed the Exchange that Pursuant to Regulation 30(1) and 30(2) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeover) Regulations, 2011, the promoters of  Iris Clothings Limited together with persons acting in concert with them, disclose their aggregate shareholding and voting rights as on March 31, 2020 in such format as prescribed and enclosed. Kindly take it on your record and reference.
